name: 30363 · Atlanta, GA
findings: ZIP 30363 (Atlanta) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30363 (Atlanta) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30363 (Atlanta) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
